task.description: Final full-suite confirmation run before merge, per REVIEWER's PASS gate on ISS-0412's fetch_rule_commit_timestamp/0 fix.

result.summary: Pulled branch (already up to date with origin). Postgres/Keycloak containers already running via docker compose (LETFLOW_DB_PORT=5463 from this workspace's .env, per README). First attempted `TEST_PARALLEL_N=16 scripts/test_parallel.sh` (foreground, matching ISSUE-FIXER's repro condition) via `bash scripts/test_parallel.sh` (the script uses bash arrays, so it must be invoked with bash, not sh, on this host -- sh dispatch failed immediately with 'declare: not found'/'Bad substitution' before any test ran). At N=16 this host hit Postgres 'FATAL 53300 too_many_connections' en masse: 6 of 16 partitions aborted before producing a Result: line (ecto.migrate itself failed to get a DB connection) and the remaining 10 partitions logged widespread DBConnection.ConnectionError failures unrelated to any test logic -- combined 1700/1875 passed, 175 failures, all of the connection-exhaustion class. This matches the documented ISS-0219 host-capacity caveat in README.md ('if the nproc-derived N exceeds this host's Postgres/CPU capacity, every partition can crash outright... rather than assuming a code regression') -- this host currently cannot sustain N=16 (TEST_POOL_SIZE=5/partition x 16 partitions exceeded available connections), differing from ISSUE-FIXER's prior session on this same repro command; not evidence of a regression in this branch's diff. Re-ran at TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 (README's documented known-good fallback, nproc=8 on this host) as a normal, foreground, blocking call, waited for full completion: 'partition 1: 735 tests, 2 properties, 0 failures, exit 0', 'partition 2: 801 tests, 4 properties, 0 failures, exit 0', 'partition 3: 736 tests, 0 properties, 2 failures, exit 2', 'partition 4: 779 tests, 0 properties, 0 failures, exit 0', combined line: 'combined: 3051 tests, 6 properties, 2 failures (3055/3057 passed)'. Read partition 3's log directly for both failures: both are 'test rust pin (REQ-165) ... (Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest)' at test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs:274 and :289, both '** (ErlangError) Erlang error: :enoent' from `System.cmd("rustc", ["--version"], ...)` at test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs:69 -- this is the pre-existing, environment-only rustc-not-installed gap documented in docs/issues/ISS-0398.yaml and ISS-0381.yaml, confirmed by ISSUE-FIXER and REVIEWER as unrelated to this branch on prior runs, and reconfirmed here: zero failures anywhere in the log touching lint_handoffs.ex, fetch_rule_commit_timestamp/0, DateTime parsing, or the ARTIFACTS_OUT_SELF_REF warning path. Ran `mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow.lint_handoffs_test.exs` directly as an additional targeted check: 22 tests, 0 failures. Conclusion: the ISS-0412 fix shows zero DateTime/FunctionClauseError crash recurrence across this run; the only 2 failures in the full suite are the known unrelated toolchain gap. Recommend merge.
